verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the dot runs in the cloud with its own computer and browser and keeps working while your device is off. It handles website logins through a private credential form, with optional saved passwords. You can take over its computer and return control, which together cover operating websites on your behalf. missing for 10: detailed documentation of browser-driven research and website task completion (e.g., navigation, form-filling, multi-step web workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the browser agent works as claimed.
